card.name: "There is" opening a sentence in CV warnings
card.fires_on: The word "There" or "is" at the start of a sentence after a period, mainly in NSAID cardiovascular-risk text. It also fires on "and" in a section heading such as "Heart Failure and Edema".

modes.label: There is/was opening a finding
modes.description: The word "There" or the "is" after it begins a sentence that states whether evidence or an effect exists.
modes.example: There<< is>> no consistent evidence that concurrent use of aspir

modes.label: Heading link word
modes.description: The word "and" joins two terms in a numbered warning section heading.
modes.example: 5.5 Heart Failure<< and>> Edema The Coxib and traditional NSA

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like turn, twist and developments, and slightly raises a few unrelated tokens, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a sentence starts with "There is" or "There was" to report whether evidence was found.
